summary: Phase 10 Modern Inbox: there are 8 acceptance criteria and each has one browser check. Only JRN-122/123 (layout and views) passes completely. The other 7 checks work in large part but each has bugs that go against the REQ lines. I confirmed every bug by reading the mock /src/api code or the component code. There is no backend, so the API lane was skipped as the briefing says.

checks.criterion: JRN-122/123 Layout, main sidebar and views
checks.name: p10-layout-views
checks.evidence: The sidebar is 240px on the dashboard, 72px on the inbox and 240px again after leaving. At 1440 the views are a flyout, and at 1920 the panel is docked. Flyout: 'Assigned to me 2 Unassigned 17 All 40 … Needs human 7 AI handling 9 Resolved 12 Closed 7 Spam 2 Trash 1 Shared views VIP & wholesale 2 Damaged on arrival 4 Sizing help 3 Private views My follow-ups Ask Goorin AI Ctrl+G'. The bell, search and New ticket are present. Conversation width: 720px at 1024, 928px at 1280, 1068px at 1440 and 1300px at 1920. Trash Delete forever with confirm works, and Spam restore brings the count to 1.

checks.name: p10-saved-views
checks.evidence: Pass: the empty name gives 'Give this view a name.', the duplicate name gives 'A view with this name already exists.', 'Email sizing' is saved as Private, selected, with the toast 'View saved' and URL ?saved=sv-…, Rename works, Make shared works, the seed counts are 2/4/3 and My follow-ups has 0 rows. FAIL: Delete removes the view at once with no confirm dialog. FAIL: after the role toggle to Agent, Rename, Make private and Delete on 'VIP & wholesale' are all enabled with no reason shown (see the agent-menu screenshot).

checks.criterion: JRN-125/126 List cards and conversation header
checks.name: p10-list-header
checks.evidence: Pass: card 'Margaret Okonkwo 5 hours ago Fedora arrived crushed — … Needs human HIGH #E3B75B' with a channel icon, the fraud chip, Select all plus the bulk bar ('21 selected Assign Tag Close'), pagination 1–25 then 26–40 of 40, breadcrumb 'All open › Margaret Okonkwo › Fedora arrived crushed…', priority, team (Returns to Wholesale), Assign me, Snooze giving 'Snoozed until Wed 12:44 AM' and Unsnooze, the ‹ › arrows, and Resolve adding the event line 'Ava Martinez changed status to Resolved'. FAIL: there is no sort control. FAIL: there is no hide-list control. FAIL: the → and ← keys do nothing; InboxPage.tsx onKey only handles j, k, r, n, e and ?.

checks.name: p10-messages-handover
checks.evidence: Pass: tinted AI cards offset to the right, 'This response was created by Goorin AI Assistant', Show reasoning expands, copy gives the 'Message copied' toast, the delivery timeline opens, Handover summary is shown, 'Intent detected by AI Agent: Damaged item / Replacement' with source icons, 'Handed over by ◇ Claude'. GB-1071 exact text: 'Not enough conversation to summarize yet. The AI needs at least 3 messages.' with Try again. FAIL: after sending a reply on GB-1076 the summary never shows 'New messages have been added since this summary was generated…'. HandoverCard.tsx never renders h.stale, and assistant.ts sets stale only for new customer messages.

checks.name: p10-composer
checks.evidence: Pass: placeholder 'Click here to reply, or press r.', 'To: jonah.abernathy@example.com', Send and Send & Resolve disabled while empty, r focuses the editor, typing 'e' in the editor does not resolve, Bold makes <strong>, 'Draft saved' shows, the macro search for 'warm' filters to 1 and inserts 'Hi Jonah, …', there are 3 suggested chips and they insert, the tip is dismissible, Send & Resolve resolves, the Internal note posts with an 'Internal note' label, and the GB-1076 Claude draft (58%) Approve gives 'Approved by Ava Martinez'. FAIL: there are no Cc/Bcc toggles in the email top row (REQ-595).

checks.criterion: JRN-129/130 Right panel and order dialogs
checks.name: p10-right-panel-orders
checks.evidence: Pass: the rail sparkle opens Ask AI, ticket tags add and remove, Note + Add, the order card has Partially refunded and Delivered pills and Edit/Duplicate/Refund, Refund at $0 is disabled, 58 + shipping 8 = $66, the refund confirms. FAIL: #GB19790 shows $194.00 and 'Up to $116.00 can be refunded ($78.00 already refunded)', but the seed is $160 total and $82 refundable (mocks/customers.ts line 40 items 78 + 2×58). FAIL: a total over the refundable amount disables the button but shows no 'Enter an amount up to $…' message. FAIL: the over-limit copy is 'This is over the AI auto-refund limit, so only a person can issue it.', not 'Above your $75 auto-refund limit…'. FAIL: no 'Refund of $58 issued by Ava' event line appears in the thread. FAIL: the Edit dialog has no quantity or remove controls, so 'An order needs at least one item' can never happen. FAIL: Duplicate reports 'Draft order #D… created' but no Draft card is added. FAIL: Create order is a blank 'Create draft' that is always enabled, with no items or total. FAIL: the wholesale store shows 'No orders in this store', not 'No orders in goorin-bros-wholesale.'. NOTE: the rail icons get no highlight state (no aria-current or aria-pressed). Past tickets for GB-1076 has '1 ticket', so Show all (shown only when >1) cannot be tested here.

checks.criterion: JRN-131/132 Ask Goorin AI and keyboard
checks.name: p10-ask-ai-keyboard
checks.evidence: Pass: Ctrl+G opens the panel; the answers use real facts (#GB20398 $148.00, Margaret, Hampton Wool Fedora); Insert into reply fills the composer; the desk-wide answer is '7 tickets need a human right now.'; axe found 0 serious/critical issues; focus ring is a 2px outline. FAIL: there is no context chip '#E3B75B · Margaret Okonkwo' (the header reads 'Ask about Margaret Okonkwo's ticket.') and no 'Whole inbox' chip. FAIL: no source chips (0 per answer). FAIL: no Loop facts; the prompt reads 'Is this order eligible for a refund?' (spec says return) and its answer is '#GB20398 is paid ($148.00). No open fraud alert…'. FAIL: the fallback reads 'I can't answer that in this demo yet. Try one of the suggested prompts.', but the spec says '…Try one of the suggestions.'. FAIL: the shortcuts modal lists only j, k, r, n, e and ?, with no →/←, N or Ctrl+G. NOTE: the desk prompts differ from the spec ('Which tickets are at risk of fraud?', 'What are customers asking about most?').

checks.name: p10-tablet-phone
checks.evidence: Pass: no horizontal overflow at 360, 390 or 430 (list) or at 390 (conversation); the composer is docked (y=538, h=188 at 390x844); no visible tap targets under 44px. FAIL: at 768 the ticket list is hidden when a ticket is open, and the right panel opens as an overlay over the conversation (see screenshot 768). FAIL: the views-dropdown switcher is not reachable at 768. FAIL: the 390 chips are 'All open 21 Needs human 7 AI handling 9 Mine 2 Unassigned 17 Resolved 12 Closed 7 All 40 Spam 2 Trash 1', with no saved views and no Views sheet. FAIL: the ⋯ ticket-actions sheet has 'Needs human High Unassigned Returns Assign me Move to spam Move to trash Resolve' and no Ask Goorin AI entry. Not verified: the Refund dialog as a sheet at 390, because the order buttons could not be reached in the phone view within the check.

bugs.title: Order #GB19790 seed is wrong: $194 total and $116 refundable instead of $160 and $82
bugs.evidence: The refund dialog reads 'Up to $116.00 can be refunded ($78.00 already refunded)', and the card reads '#GB19790 $194.00 … 3 items'. mocks/customers.ts:40 order(19790,'delivered',160,[['Dulles Newsboy',…,78],['Sage Bucket Hat',…,58,2]]) means the line items sum to 194, not 160.

bugs.title: Edit, Duplicate and Create order dialogs are stubs
bugs.evidence: The Edit dialog has only a read-only item list and 'Save changes', with no quantity, remove or address controls, so REQ-615 can't happen. Duplicate says 'Draft order #D6965 created' but no Draft card is added. Create order is 'Start a blank draft order…' with 'Create draft' always enabled and no product search or total (OrderActions.tsx lines 83-103).

bugs.title: Refund flow differs from the spec
bugs.evidence: There is no 'Enter an amount up to $X.' message when the total is over the refundable amount (only the button is disabled). The over-limit note says 'This is over the AI auto-refund limit, so only a person can issue it.'. After confirming, no 'Refund of $58 issued by Ava Martinez' event line appears (thread tail ends with the Sam Okafor note). The wholesale empty state reads 'No orders in this store'.

bugs.title: → / ← keys do not move between tickets
bugs.evidence: Pressing ArrowRight with nothing focused leaves the URL on GB-1076. InboxPage.tsx onKey handles only j, k, r, n, e, ?, N and Ctrl+G. The composer tip even says 'Press → to go to next ticket'.

bugs.title: List header has no sort control and no hide-list control (REQ-578/581)
bugs.evidence: No button named sort or hide list exists. A grep of src finds no sort UI (only the saved-view filter field 'sort') and no list-collapse handler.

bugs.title: Deleting a saved view has no confirm
bugs.evidence: InboxViewsPanel.tsx act('delete') calls viewsApi.deleteView at once. In the browser, Delete removed 'Email sizing 2' with no dialog.

bugs.title: As Agent (role toggle), Ava's shared views can still be edited and deleted
bugs.evidence: After role-toggle-agent, the 'VIP & wholesale' menu shows Rename, Duplicate, Make private and Delete all enabled with no title or reason. canManageView returns true because the toggled session keeps id u-ava (ownerId === user.id). The demo needs the Agent toggle to act as a different user, or the role check needs to apply.

bugs.title: Handover summary never shows the stale/refresh state
bugs.evidence: After sending 'tscheck-msg reply' on GB-1076, the text 'New messages have been added since this summary was generated' never appears. HandoverCard.tsx has no branch that renders h.stale. assistant.ts:27 marks stale only for customer messages, and the card state is computed once with useState.

bugs.title: Ask Goorin AI is missing the context chip, source chips and Loop facts, and some copy differs
bugs.evidence: The panel reads 'Ask Goorin AI Ask about the desk. Reading this ticket…' and then 'Ask about Margaret Okonkwo's ticket.', with no '#E3B75B · Margaret Okonkwo' chip and no 'Whole inbox' chip. There are 0 source chips per answer. The refund prompt answer has no Loop data. The fallback says '…Try one of the suggested prompts.'. The third prompt asks about 'refund' rather than 'return'.

bugs.title: Shortcuts modal does not list →/←, N or Ctrl+G
bugs.evidence: Modal text: 'Next ticket j Previous ticket k Reply r Internal note n Close ticket e Show shortcuts ?'.

bugs.title: Tablet (768) shows the conversation only, with the right panel as an overlay
bugs.evidence: At 768x1000 on /inbox/GB-1076, the ticket-list is not visible and the 'Customer & Shopify' panel opens by default over the conversation. REQ-630 requires list + conversation, with the switcher including saved views and Details as a sheet.

bugs.title: Phone: no saved views in the chips or Views sheet, and no Ask Goorin AI in ⋯
bugs.evidence: 390 chips: 'All open 21 Needs human 7 AI handling 9 Mine 2 Unassigned 17 Resolved 12 Closed 7 All 40 Spam 2 Trash 1'. The ticket-actions-sheet has no Ask Goorin AI item.

bugs.title: Composer has no Cc/Bcc toggles (REQ-595)
bugs.evidence: The composer top row has only 'Email ▾ | Internal note | To: <email>'. Composer.tsx contains no Cc or Bcc.

notes: The snooze options are 'Later today | Tomorrow | Next week'; the spec says 1 hour, Tomorrow 9am, Next week, Custom.
The bulk bar shows 'Assign Tag Close'; REQ-579 asks for Resolve and Assign, plus ⋯ for Tag, Move to spam and Move to trash.
Show reasoning on the GB-1076 AI reply shows only 'Used guidance: Damaged or defective items'. REQ-589 also lists intent, Shopify/Loop data, confidence and decision.
GB-1076 is Needs human but its banner reads 'AI replied: Grokbot answered the latest customer message. No staff handoff yet.', which contradicts the handover.
The AI draft label reads 'Claude draft · Awaiting approval' and the button is 'Approve' (spec: 'AI draft ready', 'Approve & send').
The list header has no ▾ view switcher at 1440 (REQ-578).
There is no backend, so the backend lane was skipped and no e1_tests were written.

action_items.detail: Refund dialog as a sheet at 390 was not reached by the check (order buttons are not reachable in the phone conversation view). Recheck it after the JRN-133 fixes.
GB-1076 has only 1 past ticket, so 'Show all' (shown only when there is more than 1) can't be exercised. Confirm which ticket is meant to demo it.
